data.name: landing_faq_pregunta_2
data.value: Does the AI replace professional judgment?

data.name: landing_faq_pregunta_3
data.value: How secure is my patients' data?

data.name: landing_faq_pregunta_6
data.value: Does CZ Consulting only develop Cambur?

data.name: landing_faq_respuesta_1
data.value: It's a clinical management system built for psychologists: it organizes patients, appointments, and clinical histories, and uses artificial intelligence to help draft clinical summaries, referral reports, and evolution profiles.

data.name: landing_faq_respuesta_2
data.value: No. The AI only assists in drafting documents based on the information the professional enters; every output remains subject to their review and approval before use.

data.name: landing_faq_respuesta_3
data.value: Clinical information is protected with integrity controls and an internal audit log, and access to each screen is restricted according to each user's role within the system.

data.name: landing_faq_respuesta_4
data.value: Basic, Professional, and Premium, each with different monthly usage limits. You can change your plan or payment method at any time from your dashboard.

data.name: landing_faq_respuesta_5
data.value: Yes, with no minimum commitment. If you cancel, you keep access until the end of the period you've already paid for.

data.name: landing_faq_respuesta_6
data.value: No. Our industry is software development in general; Cambur is one of our products, with a focus on HealthTech, but we also work on custom projects for other organizations.

data.name: landing_footer_texto
data.value: CZ Consulting is a software development company. Cambur is a CZ Consulting product.

data.name: landing_hero_texto
data.value: We are a software development company. We design and build custom digital products for a range of industries, and Cambur — our AI-assisted clinical management platform for mental health professionals — is one of our own products, designed and maintained by the same team that serves you today.

data.name: landing_hero_titulo
data.value: We build software that makes the work of those who care for people better

data.name: landing_nosotros_dato_3_texto
data.value: As an assistant, not a replacement

data.name: landing_nosotros_texto
data.value: CZ Consulting is a software development company. We work alongside organizations across different industries to turn processes into digital products that are simple, secure, and built to last. Our industry is software, but we choose to focus much of our effort on HealthTech: we believe technology can ease the administrative burden of those who care for others' health, without ever replacing their professional judgment.

data.name: landing_rse_pilar_1_texto
data.value: Reducing the administrative burden on mental health professionals so they can spend more time with their patients.

data.name: landing_rse_pilar_2_texto
data.value: The artificial intelligence we use assists — it never decides or replaces the professional judgment of the person using it.

data.name: landing_rse_pilar_3_texto
data.value: We support the growth of local software development, training talent and collaborating with educational institutions in the region.

data.name: landing_rse_texto
data.value: As a technology company, we understand that what we build has an impact beyond the code. These are the principles that guide our daily work.

data.name: landing_servicio_1_texto
data.value: We design and build proprietary systems end to end, tailored to how each organization actually works.

data.name: landing_servicio_2_texto
data.value: We support the digitization of existing processes: requirements gathering, architecture, information security, and integration with what the client already uses.

data.name: landing_servicio_3_texto
data.value: Our own product: a platform for psychologists that organizes patients, appointments, and clinical histories, and uses AI to generate summaries, referral reports, and evolution profiles, always under the professional's review.

data.name: landing_servicios_subtitulo
data.value: Software development services, plus a proprietary product already in use.
